commit.message: feat(memory): add reviewed AI organization suggestions (MAGI-017)

specification.objective: MAGI-017: provide an explicit, read-only AI analysis of selected stored-memory organization with reviewable, source-linked suggestions.

requirements.statement: Only an explicit user action for the selected Memory or User target may call the configured ctx.llm; no render, polling, or unrelated operation triggers analysis.

Return structured suggestions for semantic duplicates, related-entry groupings, possible contradictions, and unusually long entries; each includes a reason, exact source-text evidence, uncertainty, and references to existing source entries.
Never mutate memory during analysis or expose automatic apply actions; any future application must use the existing normal preview and explicit confirmation flow.
Reuse the active plugin ctx.llm and existing model permissions, disclose that selected memory is sent to the configured model, and limit the analysis to one bounded request with bounded output.
Discard suggestions with invalid source references or evidence that is not an exact substring of the referenced source entry.
AI, parsing, and input-limit failures produce a visible safe error and leave stored memory unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The selected-target action makes no model call until clicked; one explicit click makes one structured call and leaves both memory targets unchanged.
Valid suggestions display supported types, exact citations, reasons, uncertainty, and source entries; invalid references and quotations are discarded.
Oversized input and model/structured-output errors are visible, do not trigger retries or writes, and do not alter either store.

invariants.statement: Analysis is read-only; model output cannot directly add, edit, delete, or compact stored memory.
Only source indexes and evidence verified against the exact analyzed snapshot are returned as suggestions.
Possible contradictions are framed as uncertain findings, never asserted as proven facts.

forbidden_states.statement: An automatic model call, memory mutation, silently truncated analysis input, invalid source citation, or one-click memory application.

inputs.statement: The explicitly selected stored-memory target and its current ordered entries, within documented entry and character limits.
One structured response from the active plugin LLM context, with no retry.

outputs.statement: Bounded, source-verified, structured suggestions and safe error status; no mutation request.

failure_semantics.statement: Unavailable LLM, invalid model output, oversized data, or unexpected exception fails closed and does not touch memory.
